metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Configuration and Hardening defines preventive controls that establish a secure endpoint execution environment. These controls reduce attack surface and restrict execution paths through enforced configuration baselines and application control. This pattern is preventive by design and does not rely on runtime detection or response.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint secure configuration and application execution control.

components.title: Configuration Baselines
components.description: Definition and enforcement of approved operating system configuration baselines for endpoints.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Defense impairment via modification or disabling of endpoint security configuration.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Establishes hardened configuration states to reduce attack surface.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Develop, document, and maintain endpoint configuration baselines.

components.title: Application Control
components.description: Allowlisting and restriction of applications, scripts, and binaries permitted to execute on endpoints.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Command and scripting interpreter abuse for arbitrary code execution.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Prevents execution of unapproved code through allowlisting.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrict execution to approved applications and scripts.
Prevent execution of unauthorized or tampered software.

components.title: User-Installed Software Policy

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: defense-technique

components.title: Configuration Protection

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: defense-technique
